{{Gemini}}
Gemini 27 is the 195th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 27th day of Gemini, and it is a Saturday. It corresponds to ISO week 28, weekday 6.

Its informal Japanese name is 7宮27日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 195|Chapter 195]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152215}}.
